claim.claim-text: 2. The structure of claim 1, wherein the material of the optical cladding (106, 106a, 106b) is optically substantially transparent having regard to the selected frequencies or wavelengths.
3. The structure of any previous claim, wherein the substrate film is formed, optionally thermoformed, into a non-planar, three-dimensional target shape.

4. The structure of any preceding claim, wherein the several layers of the optical cladding (106, 106a, 106b) comprise at least two layers extending essentially parallel to a surface direction of the substrate film, said layers having at least a portion of the optically transmissive element (104) in between and comprising:

a layer (106d) between the substrate film and the transmissive element, preferably in contact with any of the film and the transmissive element, and other layer (106f) on the opposite side of the transmissive element relative to the substrate film, said other layer preferably being in contact with the transmissive element and/or optionally located between the transmissive element and an optional light blocking element.

5. The structure of any previous claim, wherein the optical cladding comprises at least two layers extending essentially parallel to a surface direction of the substrate film and at least four layers extending essentially transverse to a surface direction of the substrate film and/or wherein the several layers of the optical cladding are arranged to cover material of the transmissive element (104) from each direction at least locally, to define a shell and/or wall structure for the transmissive element at least at selected areas.

6. The structure of any previous claim, wherein the at least one light source (110) is at least partially covered by at least a portion of at least one layer of the optical cladding, preferably wherein the optical cladding is in contact with the at least one light source or wherein at least no material of the transmissive element (104) is provided between the optical cladding and the light source at the location where the optical cladding covers the light source.

7. The structure of claim 6, wherein the material and/or configuration of the portion of the cladding covering the light source is selected such that the light output by the light source reaches the transmissive element (104) to a selected extent.

8. The structure of any preceding claim, wherein the substrate film (102) comprises, at least locally, at least one element selected from the group consisting of: optically transparent material, transmissive material, translucent material, opaque volume, transparent volume, translucent volume, transmissive volume, opaque material, opaque coating, translucent coating, optically absorptive material, optically absorptive coating, absorption area, light scattering material, scattering area, light scattering coating, reflective material, reflective coating, color film, color coating, color pigment, color dye, luminescent material, printed layer, ink, colored ink, graphical pattern, and graphical figure.

9. The structure of any preceding claim, further comprising an optionally substantially opaque light absorption or scattering element (102a, 103a, 114) optionally positioned essentially between the substrate film (102) and the optically transmissive element (104), wherein the element further optionally exhibits at least one selected color, optionally provided by color pigment, color dye, color coating or color film comprised in the element.

10. The structure of any preceding claim, further comprising at least one additional film (103) on the optically transmissive element (104), on an opposite side thereof relative to a side facing the substrate film (102), wherein the additional film (103) optionally hosts or is at least adjacent at least part of the optical cladding (106, 106b), wherein the additional film (103) optionally comprises, at least locally, at least one element selected from the group consisting of: optically transparent material, transmissive material, translucent material, opaque volume, transparent volume, translucent volume, transmissive volume, opaque material, opaque coating, translucent coating, optically absorptive material, optically absorptive coating, absorptive area, light scattering material, scattering area, light scattering coating, reflective material, reflective coating, color film, color coating, color pigment, color dye, luminescent material, printed layer, ink, colored ink, graphical pattern, graphical figure, electrical element, and electronic component.

11. The structure of any preceding claim, comprising a light exit element (108, 108b) arranged adjacent the optically transmissive element (104) to outcouple light conveyed within the transmissive element and incident on the exit element from the transmissive element and optionally from the overall structure into the environment of the structure, wherein the light exit element optionally comprises at least one element selected from the group consisting of: through-hole defined in and by the material of the optical cladding to enable the conveyed light incident thereon to pass therethrough, surface relief structure, grating structure, prism structure, cladding free area or volume between the substrate film and the optically transmissive element the conveyed light is incident on, optical mask free area or volume between the transmissive element and the surface of the structure,refractive outcoupling element, diffractive outcoupling element, outcoupling element comprising optically substantially transmissive, optionally translucent or substantially transparent, material having regard to the frequency or frequency band, optically transmissive material exhibiting selected one or more colors, reflective element, and outcoupling element comprising optically transmissive material with refractive index equal to or higher than the first refractive index.

12. The structure of any preceding claim, comprising an essentially opaque, optionally reflective, absorptive or scattering, optical blocking element (116) substantially adjacent the optically transmissive element (104) and/or optical cladding (106), said optical blocking element optionally defining at least portion of light propagation, leakage, or crosstalk limiting or masking structure such as of optical structures separating such as light channels separating wall and/or of a support structure within the overall structure.

13. The structure of any preceding claim, wherein one or more materials of the optically transmissive element, optical cladding, an optical exit element or an optical blocking element included in the structure comprise at least one element selected from the group consisting of: polymer, thermoplastic material, elastomeric material, electrically insulating material, PC, PMMA, ABS, PET, nylon (PA, polyamide), polypropylene (PP), polystyrene (GPPS), and MS resin.
14. A method (500) of producing an integrated multilayer structure (100, 200, 300, 400) comprising:
15. The method of claim 14, wherein at least portion of the optical cladding is provided utilizing at least one provision technique selected from the group consisting of:

selectively upon one or more areas on the first side of the substrate film, preferably omitting the locations of one or more selected elements such as the location of at least one element selected from the group consisting of: the at least one light source, an electrical conductor, and a light absorption or scattering area or element, optionally prior to provision of the one or more selected elements on the substrate film; and substantially non-selectively upon the first side of the substrate film optionally already hosting at least one element further optionally selected from the group consisting of: the at least one light source, an electrical conductor, light exit element, and light absorption or scattering element, wherein further optionally, a masking element is first provided upon or next to the at least one element or other selected location upon the substrate film, and after provision of the optical cladding, the masking element is removed.
